The current heading reads 11). Its second digit is heavily retraced, but an earlier numeral or correction order cannot be recovered. Manuscript page 52 and pale foliation 105 are clear. H’s editorial comments about another page and earlier numbering are not source text and were not independently investigated.

The title literally reads déployement, with a descending y. Five full-dark points follow schématique. The locality parenthesis has one closing delimiter after the D in (X,D), then a comma, and its outer closing delimiter after par définition. These features are preserved without normalisation.

The source has a distinct point after fini at the end of its baseline, followed on the next baseline by I(x), with a comma. The unusual sequence fini. I(x), Par définition is retained. The first D in Pour tout pt x de D is internally crossed/retraced, but no separate old character or deletion state is established.

Germes and de sous-multiplicités are baseline words underlined once. En x is raised between germes and de with an attachment guide and is not itself underlined. The underline macros are separated to represent this layout; C’s enclosing underline range incorrectly includes the raised insertion and is counted as a definite emphasis-scope correction. Attaché[s/es] and à D each have two underline strokes.

The written expression is D_{x,i} in I(x), directly, without the separate index i and parentheses supplied by H. Its apparent typing problem is recorded rather than repaired. The parent’s mathematical check does not authorise adding that i.

The four-line diagonal note reads il vaut mieux prendre un x in X, et poser I(x)=phi si x not in D, with a final point. The small-loop/long-stem character is transcribed literally as phi. Its use for the empty set follows the written branch-set context; the reading is based on this crop, not a default adopted from another cote.

The Delta insertion’s guide attaches after ordonné. Both Delta symbols, both x indices, equality, X and the two closing curves are visible, while the opening-delimiter/equality order and possible comma-D tail remain local doubts. No clear argument tail is invented.

The final low strokes of germes are retraced. No separately bounded cancelled word after germes is established, so H’s additional struck-illegible marker is not treated as a proved error at a distinct source element. The live la codimension is raised above the cancelled Si clause; the subsequent cancelled une/avec/ceux remains doubtful.

The author introduces the digression in a smooth analytic setting and mentions proposed relative, topological and schematic alternatives. The page describes branches through x, their intersections, an ordered set and the codimension formula (149). These descriptions are reported as the author’s statements; the proposed extensions were not proved in this reading.

Root-attributed targeted check, statement 106.N.coordinate_intersections: under the usual local coordinate form of a smooth normal-crossing pair, the branches have equations z_i=0. Intersecting the distinct coordinate hypersurfaces indexed by J gives codimension |J|, and inclusion of index sets is reversed by their intersections. This checks only that conditional local-coordinate statement; it is not an independent proof for every analytic multiplicity or for the preceding proposed extensions. Reader C did not add another proof check.

There is one numbered display and no independent drawing or commutative diagram. The drawn insertion guides belong to the three insertion records. All four C cancellations and all three C insertions were checked separately for content, scope and attachment.

The first-stage apparatus had32 rows, including8 C and30 H departures. Blind review withdraws the H font-only P row; current totals are generated from the substantive flags. Unresolved endings, obscured cancelled words, Delta tails, aussi/voir, germes and the à/colon doubt are not counted as settled witness errors.

Three broad blind-reading boxes use clean boundaries and preserve every written element within them. The crowded lower region is kept together so the diagonal margin note and the Delta attachment cannot be clipped. Coverage includes all insertions, cancellations, margin notes, every C/H word difference, full doubtful expressions, and the written numeral groups 11, 52, 149 and 105. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was performed.

Blind review adds local aussi/voir and germes doubts and widens the short cancelled-word candidates. It retains the written y spelling, the live/retraced D without a certified deletion, the underline scopes, complete Delta doubts and capital Codim. The P font distinction is withdrawn from substantive H counts after local form comparison.

The root additionally viewed the existing106-B03_rotated35.png. The cursive P was inspected in this complete expression and had previously been compared with107; mathcal versus mathfrak is treated as an encoding convention, not a substantive witness error.
